name: skillvault-installation
title: SkillVault Installation
description: Manage installed SkillVault copies. Use /skillvault-installation or /sv-installation list, install, update, uninstall, or clean. Replaces skillvault-install, skillvault-list, skillvault-uninstall and /sv-install, /sv-list, /sv-uninstall. List defaults to installed copies; list catalog inspects sources; clean finds skills that load twice or conflict and shows overlaps, which skillvault-discovery evaluate can judge. Does not edit SkillVault source or application code; skillvault-authoring owns skill authoring.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Primary action; omitted means read-only list. Compatibility aliases remain in SKILL.md. Operation-specific approvals still apply.

inputs.name: skillOrFolderOrKeyword
inputs.description: Case-insensitive name fragment, folder, or keyword. Select all name matches, even when one is exact; otherwise search descriptions and paths. Omit to explore.

inputs.name: exact
inputs.description: Use --exact with install to select one literal catalog name instead of partial-name or keyword matching.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Optional second positional target: global (~/.copilot/skills), project (.github/skills), or session (current AI session only). Defaults to the resolved skill's install.defaultScope, then project.

inputs.name: version
inputs.description: Optional third positional version: latest or a skill version in v#.#.# format, installed from that skill's <skill>/v#.#.# tag. Defaults to latest.

inputs.name: repoPath
inputs.description: Explicit verified source checkout through --repo <path>. Otherwise use the known C:\repos\skillvault checkout; never silently select a cache or another session's clone. Separate from the target project.
